body:
I was not able to reproduce the crash in particular, but `set_custom_viewport()` does seem to consistently cause the following errors to occur when the CanvasLayer exits the tree.
```
ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from 'Node:<Node#26457671107>'. Signal: 'child_order_changed', callable: 'Viewport::canvas_parent_mark_dirty'.
   at: Object::_disconnect (core\object\object.cpp:1640)
Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from 'Node:<Node#26457671107>'. Signal: 'child_order_changed', callable: 'Viewport::canvas_parent_mark_dirty'.
ERROR: Parameter "viewport" is null.
   at: RendererViewport::viewport_remove_canvas (servers\rendering\renderer_viewport.cpp:1329)
servers\rendering\renderer_viewport.cpp:1329 - Parameter "viewport" is null.
```

The root cause of the error is that there's no way for a CanvasLayer to know that its custom viewport has been removed beforehand.
